entities.name: Meren
entities.description: A young Nel Toth shaman apprentice who discovers a power of death in her trial, is condemned by her clan, and returns years later as a necromancer to destroy it.

entities.name: Kael
entities.description: Meren's master, a tall Nel Toth shaman who believed in her, then called for her death after her trial.

entities.name: Elder shaman
entities.description: The old shaman of the Circle of Nel Toth who administers the Dreamfire Draught and stops Kael from killing Meren, leaving her to die alone.

entities.name: Skaal Kesh
entities.description: An ancient dragon that Meren unearthed and reforged as a weapon bound to her, which she calls down to kill Kael.

entities.name: Borrowed Ones
entities.description: Dead whom Meren revitalizes from death itself, unlike the animated corpses of Grixis necromancers.

entities.name: Circle of Nel Toth
entities.description: The clan and circle of shamans of Jund who practice blood and flesh sacrifice for savage life magic and judge Meren's trial.

entities.name: Necromancers of Grixis
entities.description: Mages of Grixis who wield darkness and animate corpses as soldiers and weapons.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The dragon-worshiping shard of Alara with tar pits, jungles and volcanic peaks, ruled by predation.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A world once divided into five shards, later reunited by the Conflux.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The hellish shard of Alara, home of necromancy, where Meren spends years learning death magic.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The event that reunited the shards of Alara and brought death magic to Jund.

entities.name: Dreamfire Draught
entities.description: A poisonous potion given to shaman apprentices in their trial that augments the senses and burns like fire.

events.summary: Meren, an apprentice shaman, is anointed by the Circle of Nel Toth with the Dreamfire Draught for her trial to become a full shaman.
events.quote: We of the Circle of Nel Toth anoint you, Meren, child of stone and blood and bone, with the Dreamfire Draught.

events.summary: Meren drinks the vial and the poison begins to burn through her.
events.quote: She tilted the vial against her lips and drained it of its contents.

events.summary: In the present, Meren finishes unearthing an ancient weapon from the bog and names it Skaal Kesh, binding it to her with the thought of vengeance.
events.quote: You are Skaal Kesh . Unearthed and bound to me.

events.summary: In the trial, a massive elemental forms from the earth and the Circle chants as Meren must bind it while poison racks her body.
events.quote: Before her, coalescing from the earth, a massive elemental reared up.

events.summary: Meren ambushes a Nel Toth hunting party, killing two warriors and the shaman and raising them as the Borrowed.
events.quote: The shaman rose from the ground and stood haltingly.

events.summary: Meren forces the dead shaman to point the way to the clan's new convening caves and sets her Borrowed party marching.
events.quote: Where are the new convening caves of the Circle.

events.summary: Flashback: the elemental recoils from Meren's greeting, breaks her arm and ribs, and she shelters in a stone dome as it rages.
events.quote: As soon as she made contact, the elemental recoiled with a roar

events.summary: Flashback: dying, Meren hears the silence between the pulses of life magic and reaches into the darkness.
events.quote: She reached into the darkness, and pulled.

events.summary: Flashback: green death fire erupts from Meren's shelter and annihilates the avalanche elemental before the astonished Circle, and she collapses.
events.quote: Nothing remained but a heap of broken rocks.

events.summary: Flashback: the Circle debates her fate and Kael declares she is no shaman and must be killed.
events.quote: We must kill her now.

events.summary: Flashback: the elder shaman stops the killing, ruling the trial continues until the draught is purged or she dies, and the Circle leaves her to die.
events.quote: Let her conclude the trial alone.

events.summary: Flashback: Kael tells Meren to die quietly and alone, and abandons her.
events.quote: Die, Meren. Die quiet and alone.

events.summary: Meren survives by drawing on the void to quench the poison, heals, and leaves Jund's clans behind following the call of darkness.
events.quote: She did not die, for on that day, she wielded death itself.

events.summary: Meren spends years in the deadlands of Grixis, learning from necromancers and discovering how to Borrow the dead.
events.quote: she learned to revitalize the deceased

events.summary: Meren leads her Borrowed Ones into the Nel Toth camp, killing a young sentry and raising fallen shamans in a bloodbath.
events.quote: The result was a bloodbath.

events.summary: Kael and two elders burn her ranks with fire and Kael challenges her as a death mage, not recognizing her until she lowers her shadow.
events.quote: Your rampage ends here, death mage!

events.summary: Meren kills the two elders, who shift into a bear and a thrinax, with fire and corruption, then reanimates them.
events.quote: Finally, it collapsed in a smoking heap at her feet.

events.summary: Kael tells Meren she should have died, then calls three avalanche elementals against her, naming her Meren Deathbender.
events.quote: Return to the earth, Meren Deathbender.

events.summary: Meren calls down Skaal Kesh, which destroys the elementals and impales Kael.
events.quote: An enormous, shadowy dragon crouched in his place, holding the broken form of Kael impaled on its claws.

events.summary: Meren has Skaal Kesh devour Kael, completing her vengeance.
events.quote: Vengeance served.

events.summary: Meren, last of Clan Nel Toth, vows to topple all the cairns of Jund.
events.quote: And she would not stop until all of the cairns of Jund were toppled.

relations.note: Kael was Meren's master in the Nel Toth.
relations.quote: finding her master, Kael, sitting tall and proud, watching closely.

relations.note: Meren began as a shaman apprentice of the Nel Toth.
relations.quote: You are Meren, shaman apprentice of the Nel Toth.

relations.note: Meren unearthed and reforged the dragon Skaal Kesh.
The dragon is bound to Meren and obeys her commands.
Skaal Kesh devours Kael at Meren's command.
relations.quote: she watched the dragon consume the last remnants of her past in two great bites.

relations.note: Meren seeks vengeance on the clan that tried to condemn her to death.
relations.quote: Now, she brought death to those who had tried to deliver it unto her.

relations.note: The Borrowed Ones are raised and commanded by Meren.
relations.quote: With a gesture, the party again marched

relations.note: Jund is one of the five shards of Alara.
relations.quote: Far from Zendikar lies the fivefold world of Alara .
